evidence.title: When Not to Imitate: Boundary-Aware Skill Memory for Reliable Tool-Use LLM Agents

summary: Researchers propose a novel framework to improve the reliability of AI agents by preventing harmful imitation in tool-use scenarios. The method, called 'Boundary-Aware Skill Memory,' helps LLMs distinguish safe and effective actions from risky ones.
title: New AI Research Introduces Boundary-Aware Skill Memory for Reliable Tool-Use in LLM Agents
